tests_run.name: mcp_analysis_disasm_at_path_wasm
tests_run.comparison: mnemonic, operand values, and instruction size MATCH across all 3 instructions. MCP output does not surface BranchFlags textually but the underlying Architecture::disassemble flags are equivalent (validator includes CALL/RET tags; MCP wire format omits them — informational only, not a semantic mismatch).

overlap_analysis: analysis_disasm_at_path_wasm exercises the same WasmArch::disassemble code path the validator mirrors. Direct functional comparison was possible (unlike arm64/mips/riscv which need a loadable container) because the MCP path-disasm bypasses the loader for the wasm arch and reads bytes at the given file offset. Header/valtype/section/leb128 helpers have no MCP surface so they are covered only by the validator self-tests.
